title: YouTube Title & Thumbnail Change Intelligence input
description: Paste public YouTube channel URLs, @handles, or IDs. The Actor preserves packaging variants and ranks the strongest observed signals.

youtubeApiKey.title: YouTube Data API key
youtubeApiKey.description: Your Google API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Restrict the key to that API in Google Cloud. Apify masks this secret input.

channels.title: Competitor channels
channels.description: Paste ordinary channel URLs, @handles, or canonical IDs. Up to 100 channels per run.

recentVideosPerChannel.title: Recent videos per channel
recentVideosPerChannel.description: Number of recent uploads inspected for each channel on every run.

monitorKey.title: Monitor key
monitorKey.description: Stable key for this watchlist. Keep it unchanged on scheduled runs.

changeWindowDays.title: Post-change measurement window
changeWindowDays.description: Maximum age of a detected change for one follow-up velocity observation.

impactSamplesPerChange.title: Impact samples per change
impactSamplesPerChange.description: Number of unchanged follow-up observations used to form a machine-readable response curve.

publishedWithinDays.title: Maximum video age
publishedWithinDays.description: Ignore older videos to focus spend on active packaging decisions.

minimumViews.title: Minimum public views
minimumViews.description: Ignore videos below this public view count.

minimumSignalScore.title: Minimum signal score
minimumSignalScore.description: Only deliver packaging events at or above this deterministic 0–100 score.

emitBaseline.title: Emit baseline rows
emitBaseline.description: When enabled, first-seen videos are written as BASELINE_VIDEO records. The baseline is always stored.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint receiving the change records and run summary.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each YouTube API or thumbnail request.
